integrity: The proof is self-contained; numerical finite cutoff checks support but do not establish the asymptotic statements.
scientific_limitations: Applies to mean-zero L2 on the unit-period circle and the rectangular averaging kernel; no uniform error rates in irrational angle or near-rational detuning and no statistical minimax conclusions. Some historical Steklov full text was unavailable, and literature priority awaits independent examination.
title: A rational-window spectral boundary layer for periodic boxcar averaging
